verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source, client-side 3D rendering and game engine distributed as npm packages. It has no hosted API or account system, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a credentialed service: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, and only an npm library and docs exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
